title: Ref2VA single-subject Reference Sheet identity
description: A focused single-subject Ref2VA vision fixture for complementary multi-view Reference Sheet identity behavior.
humanReview: Is the Reference Sheet interpreted as one Subject rather than multiple people or duplicated versions of Subject 1?
Does the generated prompt synthesize a coherent stable identity from the sheet rather than reproducing its grid, panels, labels, or sheet background?
When side, rear, and three-quarter views are requested, does the prompt use the Reference Sheet as complementary multi-view evidence without treating those views as separate characters?
Are hairstyle, wardrobe, silhouette/body proportions, and recognizable appearance kept consistent while pose and camera angle change?
Are expression-example panels treated only as identity/deformation evidence rather than as an ordered expression sequence or mandatory target expressions?
Does the requested hallway walk, camera arc, stop, turn, and final three-quarter pose remain the target action?
